# Nutmeg

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P18](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## Appearance

Nutmeg features gold and green plumage. At times, he puffs out his feathers to such an extent that he resembles a sphere.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036)_

## Personality

Nutmeg is a parrot known for a habit of using foul language. The creature is described as exceptionally wicked.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## History

Nutmeg was a pet parrot given to Mr. J. A. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) by his brother, a seafaring man who named the bird and sent him during his final illness. The parrot once bit a chunk out of John Henry Carter's neck when he leaned too close to the cage, and he ultimately became the final point of contention that caused the separation of Mr.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), +2 more_
